title: family_rule_reset
description: Remove the device adjustment of one manageable rule on each listed child device (back to the profile value). Also removes adjustments the admin set (last writer wins, logged). Family manager devices only (effective rule family_manager); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_result.

request_id.description: Optional id of the app, echoed in the answer.

client_ids.description: Child devices (e.g. all devices of one child). Each is checked on its own (family_result.results).
